questions.question: What do dedication and commitment mean? Give an example of each.
questions.expected_answer: Dedication means giving a lot of time and effort to something and not giving up when it is hard, like Mrs Dlamini teaching for thirty years or Albert Luthuli working for freedom for many years. Commitment means keeping your promises to others and staying loyal, like Luthuli staying true to his belief in freedom for all.

questions.question: What sacrifice did Albert Luthuli make in 1952, and why?
questions.expected_answer: The government told him to leave the ANC or lose his position as chief. He refused to leave the ANC because he was committed to the struggle for freedom, so he was removed as chief and later banned.

questions.question: How did Mahatma Gandhi show commitment and sacrifice in South Africa?
questions.expected_answer: Gandhi lived in South Africa from 1893 to 1914 and was committed to helping Indian South Africans treated unfairly. He led peaceful protests called satyagraha, breaking unfair laws without violence, and he accepted going to prison several times.
